import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    L = np.log(A); E = np.exp(-A); s = np.sqrt(t)
    p = params
    return (p[0] + p[1]*s + p[2]*t + p[3]*A*s + p[4]*A*t + p[5]*A**2*s
            + p[6]*A*L + p[7]*A*L*s + p[8]*A**3*s + p[9]*A*E*s)
